A normal 47 minute walk to work took me 43 minutes this morning. I think walking down this past week has definitely improved my fitness levels, so win! 🙌🏻
Blimey, just realised it's been 6 months today since I quit smoking. Even going through difficult times and I wanted nothing more, but I persevered. I'm so bloody proud of myself. 😁

I dusted off the xbox and played some kinect games today. One way to keep active during lockdown. Been dancing, doing some cardio boxing and some yoga. Fair to say I'm hot, sweaty and absolutely knackered 😅

It would seem that quitting smoking, grief and lockdown have had a mega impact on my health. First time on the scales in months and I've piled the weight on. Any advice or tips to trying to lose weight again? How do you resist comfort eating?

A week today I started calorie counting. Not gonna lie, I had a couple mental health blips, where I didn't record anything. But in a week I've lost 5lbs! Keeping active too of course, and I'm not denying myself the pleasure of having a dippy biscuit with my cup of tea.
